description.p: BentoVM is a front end for QEMU/KVM that treats Venus (Vulkan) and VirGL GPU acceleration as first-class citizens, so GPU-accelerated virtual machines no longer need a hand-written QEMU command line. VMs run as your user, without root or libvirt.

ul.li: Venus, VirGL or 2D graphics, shown in a built-in display
Clipboard sharing with a per-VM direction, and drag & drop of files into the VM
USB passthrough for game controllers, drives and more
A setup wizard that detects the OS from the ISO and recommends CPU and memory
Several storage locations; VMs on a disconnected drive show as temporarily unavailable
Native KDE look, or the built-in Modern Dark and Modern Light themes
